description: This file implements the SpdyWriteQueue class, which manages a queue of SPDY protocol frames for network streams, including enqueueing, dequeueing, removing, and changing priorities of queued frames.

classes.name: SpdyWriteQueue::PendingWrite
classes.description: Represents a pending SPDY frame write, including frame type, producer, associated stream, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: IsSpdyFrameTypeWriteCapped
methods.description: Checks if a given SPDY frame type is write-capped.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::PendingWrite(spdy::SpdyFrameType, std::unique_ptr<SpdyBufferProducer>, const base::WeakPtr<SpdyStream>&, const MutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag&)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing a PendingWrite with frame type, producer, stream, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::IsEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty across all priorities.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new frame to the queue with specified priority, type, producer, stream, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the highest priority frame from the queue.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::RemovePendingWritesForStream
methods.description: Removes all pending writes associated with a specific stream.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::RemovePendingWritesForStreamsAfter
methods.description: Removes all writes for streams with IDs greater than a specified last good stream ID.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::ChangePriorityOfWritesForStream
methods.description: Changes the priority of all pending writes for a specific stream.

methods.name: SpdyWriteQueue::Clear
methods.description: Clears all pending writes from the queue.
